def q_to_axes(qx, qy, qz, qw):
    # X axis
    xx = 1 - 2 * (qy * qy + qz * qz)
    xy = 2 * (qx * qy + qz * qw)
    xz = 2 * (qx * qz - qy * qw)
    # Y axis
    yx = 2 * (qx * qy - qz * qw)
    yy = 1 - 2 * (qx * qx + qz * qz)
    yz = 2 * (qy * qz + qx * qw)
    # Z axis
    zx = 2 * (qx * qz + qy * qw)
    zy = 2 * (qy * qz - qx * qw)
    zz = 1 - 2 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)
    return (
        [round(xx, 3), round(xy, 3), round(xz, 3)],
        [round(yx, 3), round(yy, 3), round(yz, 3)],
        [round(zx, 3), round(zy, 3), round(zz, 3)],
    )


gp = obs.output["observation_summary"]["state_fields"]["gripper_pose"]
print(

    [round(x, 4) for x in gp[:3]],
    "axes:",

)

    )
